newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina aims for 3-4 pct growth in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Argentina aims for 3-4 pct growth in 1996.

text.p: Argentina's economy will grow between three and four percent this year provided second-half GDP growth is six percent, Planning Secretary Eugenio Pendaz said Monday.
"This way we would compensate for the flat growth of the first half of the year," he told reporters.
Pendaz said all sectors were recovering in tandem, the same as imports which were growing at a steady pace.
The official also said Argentina in September hopes to seal negotiations for an $800 million World Bank and Interamerican Development Bank credit.
The credit, offered to help plug the budget hole caused by the introduction of private pension schemes in Argentina two and a half years ago, is due to be disbursed by the end of 1996.
He also estimated next year's fiscal deficit would be less than 1.0 percent of GDP.
